en.title: The definite article
en.summary: The definite article the is used when the listener knows which thing we mean.

paragraphs: The definite article is the. We use it when the listener knows which thing or person we mean. This can be because it was mentioned before, because it is clear from the situation, or because there is only one. English has one definite article for every noun, singular or plural.

items: I have a cat. **The** cat is black.

paragraphs: The has one spelling, but two pronunciations. Before a consonant sound it is /ðə/, and before a vowel sound it is /ðiː/. We also use the with unique things, with superlatives, with ordinal numbers and with some names, such as rivers and groups of islands.

blocks.html:
UseExample
known thingPass me the salt.
second mentionI saw a man. The man was tall.
unique thingthe moon, the sky
superlativethe fastest car
ordinalthe first day

paragraphs: Compare Dogs are loyal and The dogs next door are loud. The first sentence speaks about all dogs, so there is no article. The second names particular dogs that both speakers can identify, so we need the.
Some phrases need the: in the morning, on the left, the same, the radio, play the piano. Others do not: at home, in bed, go to work. These phrases are best learned whole.

items: Wrong: **Sun is hot.** Right: **The sun is hot.**
Wrong: **I like the music.** (in general) Right: **I like music.**
Wrong: **She plays piano.** Right: **She plays the piano.**

ro.title: Articolul hotărât
ro.summary: În limba română, articolul hotărât se adaugă direct la sfârșitul cuvântului pentru a arăta un lucru cunoscut.

paragraphs: Articolul hotărât arată o persoană sau un lucru bine cunoscut. În limba română, el se adaugă la sfârșitul cuvântului. Folosim acest articol când vorbim despre ceva precis.
Forma articolului depinde de genul și numărul cuvântului. La masculin singular adăugăm de obicei „-ul” sau „-l”. La feminin singular punem terminația „-a”. La plural adăugăm de regulă „-i” sau „-le”.
